newsitem.title: INDONESIA: German tourist dies in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: German tourist dies in Indonesia.

text.p: A German tourist has apparently drowned in waters off Indonesia's most western province of Aceh, the official Antara news agency reported on Tuesday.

Dietmar Horst Adolf, 46, died around midday on Monday while "playing in the waves" at a tourist spot about 138 km (85 miles) west of the provincial capital Banda Aceh, said Major Muhammad Akmil, the deputy chief of the West Aceh police district.
"The victim's body was found by local people a few metres from the scene of the accident and has already been take to Banda Aceh for an autopsy before being flown to his country," Akmil said.
Police said the man was swimming alone in the ocean when he appeared to be dragged along by a current while a woman friend sunbathed on the beach. There were no suspicious circumstances, locals said.
